notes: Every capture is the PNG and the record the TASK-033 harness (e2e/design-0143/baseline.spec.ts) wrote in one run. Values are transcribed from those records; nothing is reconstructed or inferred from a picture.

identity, baseline, phase, deterministic and liveGeneration were identical in all fifteen records and are stated once; they apply to every capture.

The merged harness reaches five states of five route entries, in the clear skin, at three viewports. matrix and coverage state exactly what was and was not captured. A state that is not listed under a capture has no before-state screenshot.
The target was the harness's owned local server. This is not deployed proof and not live generation proof.
No contact sheet is recorded: none was produced in this session, and none is claimed.

notCaptured.reason: No Playwright project maps to it in the merged harness.

skins.reason: The merged baseline spec pins the default skin.

negativeCases.observed: BootGate showed "System check failed"; captureTarget rejected the Generate target.
